name: Ferrogate Cargo Trike
description: A three-wheeled electric cargo vehicle ubiquitous in Tier 1-3 commercial districts. Open cab, flatbed rear, rated for 500 kg of cargo. They're the backbone of small-scale commerce in GLMZ — every street vendor, repair shop, and small business owner either has one or wishes they did. Reliable, ugly, and nearly indestructible. Ferrogate's only product that people actually like.
armament: None. Cargo tie-downs can be repurposed creatively.
common_usage: Small business deliveries, market vendors, repair technicians, general hauling.
story_hooks: A cargo trike driver has been unknowingly hauling smuggled goods hidden in their battery compartment
The Ferrogate Cargo Trike racing league is the most wholesome thing in GLMZ and everyone protects it
